tips.text: Stay out of damage for a few seconds and Perseverance heals you fast. Back off after a trade and let your health refill.
Open a trade with Decisive Strike on your next attack. The enemy is silenced, so they can't cast abilities to escape or fight back.
Use Decisive Strike to get away from slows. It removes them and gives you speed to chase or run.
Aim Judgment so it hits only the enemy champion, not the minions. It does the most damage to a single target.
Stay on the enemy for the whole of Judgment. Enough hits cut their Armor, and your follow-up attacks then hurt more.
Press Courage when the enemy starts a big trade or burst. It cuts damage and gives a brief shield.
Last-hit minions and kill enemies yourself. Each kill permanently adds Armor and Magic Resist through Courage.
Finish low-health enemies with Demacian Justice. It does more damage the less health they have, so use it to close a kill.

combos.name: Q reset auto
combos.when: When you want to start a trade or chase a fleeing enemy.
combos.text: Decisive Strike gives move speed and resets your attack timer. The empowered attack lunges at the target and silences it, so cast Q as you close in.

tips.text: Use Decisive Strike to clear Infernal Chains' slow and run down the enemy, then hit them to silence them.
Walk toward the sides or straight at Aatrox to escape Infernal Chains instead of away from him. Stay out of the pull.
Step out of the telegraphed zones of The Darkin Blade. Its edge knocks you up, so don't stand at the far end.
Trade with Judgment when only Aatrox is in range, so he takes full damage and gets his Armor cut.
Use Courage when Aatrox lands a combo on you; it cuts incoming damage and gives a shield.
Finish Aatrox with Demacian Justice when he is low. His healing makes it best to strike as soon as he is in range.
Close the gap with Decisive Strike's speed, then hit Akali to silence her. She can't cast abilities to escape.
Decisive Strike also removes slows, so use it when Five Point Strike slows you.
Use Courage when Akali commits her combo; it cuts her damage and gives you a shield.
Start Judgment when Akali is on top of you, with only her in range, so it deals full damage.
Akali can still be hit by area damage in Twilight Shroud, so Judgment can reveal her. Do not chase blindly into smoke.
Use Demacian Justice when Akali is low on health; it deals more the more health she is missing.
Avoid damage between fights so Perseverance heals you; stay out of poke range.
Use Decisive Strike to cleanse Ambessa's slow from Lacerate, then hit her to silence her so she can't cast her abilities or dash away.
Press Courage when Ambessa starts Repudiation or dives on you; it cuts the damage you take and gives a brief shield.
Trade with Judgment when only Ambessa is in range; a lone target takes the most damage, and enough spins also lower her Armor.
Stay healthy as the lane goes on. Once her health is low, Demacian Justice finishes her fast, so use it on her when she is low.
Step out of range after a trade and avoid damage so Perseverance heals you back up.
Use Decisive Strike when Anivia's Flash Frost slows you; it removes the slow and speeds you up to close in.
Silence Anivia with Decisive Strike once you reach her; she cannot cast spells while silenced.
Walk around Crystallize rather than waiting; the wall melts after a few seconds, so do not waste cooldowns on it.
Her egg is hard to kill early, so use Demacian Justice on her only when it finishes her, not before Rebirth is used up.
Use Courage to blunt her Frostbite and Flash Frost damage when she starts a combo.
Walk up and hit Aurora with Decisive Strike when she is close; it silences her, so she can't use her dashes or spells for a moment.
Decisive Strike also clears slows, so use it when The Weirding hits you and you want to close the gap.
Aurora wins at long range, so don't chase her blindly. Wait for her to use up Twofold Hex and The Weirding, then go in.
Press Courage when Aurora's burst is coming; it cuts the damage you take and gives a shield.
Aurora is a mage with little to stop you once you're on her. Keep Judgment on her alone, since she is then the nearest enemy and takes extra damage.
Finish her with Demacian Justice once she is low. It can't be dodged by her invisibility if you are already in range.
Stay out of damage between fights so Perseverance heals you. Aurora's poke keeps it off, so punish her when she wastes her spells.
Save Decisive Strike for when Briar leaps in; it silences her, and she is stunned by nothing of yours so land it on her first hit back.
Use Courage when Briar is on you in Blood Frenzy; the damage reduction and shield blunt her fast attacks.
Spin Judgment when Briar is stuck attacking you; she is forced to hit the nearest enemy, so she stays in range.
Finish Briar with Demacian Justice when she is low; her healing is strong, so do not wait for her to bleed you first.
Stay out of the wall when Briar charges Chilling Scream; a full charge knocks you back and stuns you if you hit terrain.
Use Decisive Strike to walk up and hit Camille; it silences her, so she can't use her abilities for a moment to trade back.
Decisive Strike removes slows from you, so walk into Tactical Sweep's outer edge without fear and close the gap.
Press Courage when Camille's Hookshot stun is about to land or she starts a trade; it cuts damage and gives you tenacity briefly.
Fight Camille with Judgment when only she is in range; it hits hardest on one target and cuts her Armor if it keeps hitting.
Stay out of unwarded brush and walls where Camille can dive in with Hookshot. Staying healthy lets Perseverance heal you.
Finish Camille with Demacian Justice once she is low; her Hextech Ultimatum zone won't save her from it.
Watch for the smoke cloud on the ground from Rupture and walk out of it. The knock up leaves you open to Cho'Gath's follow-up.
Use Decisive Strike to remove a slow and close the gap. Its silence stops Cho'Gath casting abilities on you.
Trade with Judgment when Cho'Gath is close and alone, so it all lands on him. Walk up and spin when his Feral Scream is on cooldown.
Press Courage when Cho'Gath goes for a combo. It cuts the damage and gives a shield.
Don't let Cho'Gath grow. Keep pressure on him and kill him before he stacks Feast, then finish him with Demacian Justice once his health is low.
Use Decisive Strike to cleanse the slow when Darius hits you with Crippling Strike or Apprehend, then run him down or step away.
Hit Darius with Decisive Strike to silence him in a trade; he can't use his abilities for a moment.
Use Courage when Darius swings Decimate or goes for a full trade; it cuts his damage and gives you a shield.
Spin Judgment when Darius walks up to you, but stay inside his reach only while it is worth the trade.
Stay away from Darius when he has full Hemorrhage stacks; his damage jumps. Fight when his stacks are low.
Finish Darius with Demacian Justice once he is low; it deals true damage that grows with his missing health.
Stay out of the pull when Apprehend is ready; step out of its cone and Darius loses his best way to start a fight.
Back off and let Perseverance heal you when you are not being hit. Darius's poke can break it, so stay out of his range.
Walk through your minions when Mundo throws Infected Bonesaw; it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Use Decisive Strike to remove the slow from Infected Bonesaw and run at Mundo. Its silence stops Heart Zapper.
When Mundo starts Heart Zapper, back off or use Courage. His heal is smaller if his recast hits nothing.
Mundo regenerates fast. Burst him with Demacian Justice when he is low and Maximum Dosage is on cooldown.
Stay out of Mundo's Infected Bonesaw range to keep Perseverance regenerating your health.
Don't use Decisive Strike or Courage while Fiora is in Riposte. She parries the silence and shrugs off the hit, so wait until it ends.
Bait out Riposte with a cheap hit, then start your trade. Spin Judgment once it is on cooldown.
Use Decisive Strike to catch Fiora when she lunges in. The silence stops her from casting Riposte or Lunge.
Decisive Strike clears slows, so Bladework's slow won't hold you. Use its speed boost to close the gap on Fiora.
Look for the kill with Demacian Justice once Fiora is low. Her Vital healing is easy to out-damage with a burst.
Stay out of fights when she has Grand Challenge up on you. Fall back and let Perseverance heal you.
Close in with Decisive Strike for speed, then hit Gangplank to silence him so he cannot heal with Remove Scurvy.
Do not stand beside Gangplank's Powder Keg when he can shoot it; step away or you take the blast and get slowed.
Use Courage when Gangplank starts a keg combo to take less damage.
Spin with Judgment once you are on top of Gangplank; it hurts most when he is the only one hit.
When Gangplank is low, finish him with Demacian Justice.
Gnar outranges you as Mini Gnar, so don't chase him down in the open. Wait until he throws Boomerang Throw or Hop, then walk up and trade.
Use Decisive Strike when Gnar slows you; it removes the slow and speeds you up so you can close the gap, and your next hit silences him.
Fight Gnar while he is Mini Gnar, since he is squishy. Be ready to back off when his Rage is full, because Mega Gnar is much tougher.
Stay away from walls when Gnar is big, because GNAR! stuns you and hurts more if it throws you into one.
Press Courage when Mega Gnar is about to use Wallop or GNAR!. It cuts the damage you take and gives you a shield and tenacity for a moment.
Gnar can't gain Rage for a while after he turns small again. Push the fight then, and use Judgment while only he is in range to deal the most damage.
Finish Gnar with Demacian Justice once he is low, since it deals more damage the less health he has.
Walk out of Barrel Roll's area or use Decisive Strike to shake off its slow.
Use Decisive Strike on Gragas when he goes for a trade; the silence stops his abilities.
Press Courage when Gragas starts a Body Slam combo; the shield and tenacity cut the stun.
Gragas can knock you away with Explosive Cask, so do not stand near your own tower when he has it up.
Spin Judgment only when Gragas is the single target near you, to make it hit hardest.
Gragas's Drunken Rage cuts his damage taken, so wait for it to end before you burst him with Demacian Justice.
Use Decisive Strike to chase Gwen; the move speed closes the gap and the silence stops her from escaping with Hallowed Mist or dashing away.
Gwen's Needlework slows, so Decisive Strike is a good answer: it removes slows from you and lets you close in.
Don't waste Demacian Justice while Gwen stands in Hallowed Mist; you can't target her from outside it. Wait for her to leave or for the Mist to end.
Trade when Gwen's Skip 'n Slash is on cooldown, because her empowered attacks are what let her out-trade you.
Use Courage when Gwen commits a full Snip Snip! or Needlework combo; it cuts the damage you take.
Finish Gwen with Demacian Justice once she is low; it deals true damage based on her missing health.
Walk through your minions and stay out of the grenade's centre; Heimerdinger's stun is what lets him win the trade.
Use Decisive Strike to remove his slows and run in; the speed boost helps you close the gap.
Hit Heimerdinger with Decisive Strike when you reach him; the silence stops him from casting for a moment.
Use Courage when his grenade or rockets are about to land; the shield and tenacity cut the stun short.
Spin Judgment on Heimerdinger and his turrets together once you are on him; he cannot easily escape it.
Finish Heimerdinger with Demacian Justice when he is low; he has few ways to heal.
Kill Tentacles when they are alone and out of Illaoi's reach; she is much weaker in fights without them.
Use Judgment on Illaoi only, away from her Tentacles and minions, so the nearest-enemy bonus lands on her.
Use Decisive Strike to remove the slow when she pulls your spirit out with Test of Spirit, then silence her with your next attack.
Press Courage when Illaoi leaps in with Harsh Lesson and her Tentacles slam; it cuts the damage you take.
Look for Demacian Justice once Illaoi is low, since it deals more damage the less health she has.
Hold Decisive Strike for when Irelia dashes at you. The Silence stops her casting abilities and you can chase her down.
Step out of the line between Irelia's two blades from Flawless Duet, or you'll be stunned. Decisive Strike will not free you from it.
Don't spend Judgment or Demacian Justice on Irelia while she's charging Defiant Dance, because it cuts the damage she takes.
Fight Irelia when her Ionian Fervor stacks have run out. She loses a lot of Attack Speed and damage then.
Push the wave so Irelia has fewer minions to dash through, and fight her away from the minions.
Use Courage when Irelia commits to a trade. It reduces her damage and gives you a shield.
Do not attack Jax while he is in Counter Strike. Wait for it to end, then trade.
Use Judgment while Jax is stunned or dodging; its spins are not basic attacks, so he cannot dodge them.
Decisive Strike silences Jax, so use it to stop him from casting Leap Strike when he tries to jump on you or away.
Jax gets stronger the longer he keeps hitting you. Use Courage to cut his damage when he is attacking.
Use Decisive Strike to remove the slow from To the Skies!, then run him down and silence him with your next attack so he can't jump away.
Press Courage when Jayce starts a big trade; it cuts incoming damage and gives you a shield.
Walk through your minions when he fires Shock Blast. It stops at the first enemy it hits.
Stay close to Jayce and spin Judgment when only he is in range. It hurts most against a single target.
Hold Demacian Justice until Jayce is low. It deals more damage the less health he has, so use it to finish him.
Stay out of his poke range when his Cannon is out. Shove the wave and let Perseverance heal you when he leaves.
Use Decisive Strike when K'Sante's Ntofo Strikes slows you; it removes the slow and speeds you up so you can close in.
Hit K'Sante with Decisive Strike to silence him, so he can't dash away or stun you with Path Maker for a moment.
Press Courage when K'Sante starts charging Path Maker or lands a pull; it cuts damage and shortens the stun.
Hold Demacian Justice until K'Sante is low or has gone All Out; he loses health then, so the true damage finishes him.
Spin with Judgment only when K'Sante is the sole target nearby, so he takes full damage and loses Armor.
Pressure Kayle hard before level 6. She is a weak melee champion until she ascends, so trade and push her out of lane.
Use Decisive Strike to close the gap; it speeds you up and silences Kayle, so she can't cast her spells.
Decisive Strike also removes slows, so Radiant Blast won't stop your chase for long.
Spin Judgment while you stand next to Kayle. She is fragile and it hurts most when it hits only her.
Once Kayle has range, her attacks get dangerous. Don't walk into her unless you can reach her.
When Kayle casts Divine Judgment, don't waste damage on the invulnerable target. Back off, then hit whoever is left standing.
Finish Kayle with Demacian Justice once she is low. She is fragile and has little else to stop it.
Close in on Kennen when he uses Lightning Rush carelessly. He is flimsy and can't attack while it lasts.
Use Decisive Strike to chase Kennen. It removes slows from you, gives you speed, and silences him on the hit.
Step into the lane's side to dodge Thundering Shuriken, and stand behind minions so it hits them instead of you.
Turn on Courage when Kennen has landed marks on you, to blunt the damage and gain a shield before the stun.
Spin with Judgment once you reach Kennen, since he has little health to survive it. Keep him as the only target so it hits hardest.
Finish a hurt Kennen with Demacian Justice at level 6.
Start your trade with Decisive Strike on the first hit; the silence stops Kled from casting right away and the move speed helps you close in.
Decisive Strike removes slows, so use it when Bear Trap on a Rope has pulled you and you are slowed.
Use Courage when Kled's Violent Tendencies is ready; it cuts the damage of his fast attacks.
Keep Judgment for when Kled is alone next to you, so he takes full damage and loses Armor.
Finish Kled with Demacian Justice once Skaarl is gone and he is low; he is easier to kill while dismounted.
Step out of the line of Bear Trap on a Rope, because it hooks the first champion it hits.
Use Decisive Strike right after Seismic Shard hits; it clears the slow so you can keep chasing or escape.
Silence Malphite with Decisive Strike when he walks up to trade, so he cannot cast his spells.
Press Courage when Malphite casts Ground Slam or Thunderclap; it cuts the damage you take and gives a brief shield.
Break Granite Shield before you commit with Judgment, or your damage is wasted on his high Armor.
Keep Demacian Justice for when Malphite is low; his shield does not stop true damage.
Use Decisive Strike to get close. It makes Mordekaiser silenced, so he cannot cast Obliterate or Death's Grasp.
Stay out of a long fight once Darkness Rise is on. His aura hurts you every second near him.
Walk beside minions when Death's Grasp is coming. Stand away from them when you want to hit him.
Use Courage when his Obliterate lands, to shrink the hit. It also helps against his aura.
Hit Mordekaiser when his Indestructible is on cooldown, so he has no shield to take your damage.
Stay away from low health around Mordekaiser. Realm of Death cuts you off from help and from your own ultimate.
Use Decisive Strike to silence Naafiri when she dashes in, so she cannot use her abilities mid-trade.
Spin Judgment when Naafiri and her packmates are all close; it hits everything around you. Step in only when you can stay on her.
Press Courage just before her burst lands; the damage cut and shield blunt her trade.
Finish Naafiri with Demacian Justice once she is low. It does more damage the less health she has.
Stay out of her fights when you are hurt. Perseverance heals you only after you avoid damage for a while, so back off and let it work.
Save Decisive Strike for when Nasus has used Wither. It removes the slow and gives you speed to close in, and the hit silences him.
Trade with Judgment when only Nasus is near you, so he takes full damage. Spin away from minions that soak it up.
Hit Nasus early, before Siphoning Strike has stacked up. His last hits grow his damage over time.
Use Courage when Nasus goes for a big trade. It cuts the damage you take and gives you a shield.
Finish Nasus with Demacian Justice once his Health is low. Do not chase him into Fury of the Sands, where he is far tougher.
Walk out of the way of Olaf's Undertow axe; if it hits, you are slowed and lose Armor.
Use Decisive Strike to remove the slow from Undertow and close in. Your next attack silences him.
Stand between Olaf and his axe so he cannot pick it up and throw Undertow again quickly.
Do not try to stun or lock Olaf down while Ragnarok is up; he is immune. Back off or wait it out.
Use Courage when Olaf comes in with Tough It Out, to blunt his trade.
Finish a hurt Olaf with Demacian Justice before he becomes dangerous.
Stay out of walls' reach when Ornn is near; Searing Charge only stuns you if he slams into terrain beside you. Fight in open space.
Use Decisive Strike to shake off the slow from Volcanic Rupture, then hit Ornn to silence him and stop his spells.
Trade with Judgment when only Ornn is in range, so he takes the full damage. Back off before his Bellows Breath lands.
Press Courage when Ornn commits to a trade; it cuts the damage you take and gives a brief shield.
Stay out of his fire and keep your distance; Perseverance only heals you when you avoid damage for a while.
Finish a hurt Ornn with Demacian Justice. It deals true damage, so his armor and magic resist won't reduce it.
Walk up and use Judgment only when Pantheon is close, and keep minions out of its range so it hits only him.
Save Courage for when Pantheon jumps on you with Shield Vault. It cuts the damage you take in the trade.
Use Decisive Strike to close the gap when Pantheon backs off, since it also gives you move speed. His spells go quiet while he is silenced.
Go around Pantheon when he braces with Aegis Assault, since he blocks damage from the front. Wait out the channel.
Step out of the way of Comet Spear when he holds it to throw it. His spear hurts more against low-health targets.
Look for Demacian Justice once Pantheon is low, as the damage grows with his missing health. Do not let him trade you down first.
Quinn's Blinding Assault is a straight line that stops at the first enemy. Stand behind a minion so it hits that minion instead of you.
Use Decisive Strike after she slows you with Vault; it removes the slow and gives you speed to close the gap. Your next hit silences her.
Fight in a lane where she is alone. Spin Judgment on only her, because it hits hardest on a single target.
Turn on Courage when she starts a trade. It cuts her damage and gives you a shield.
Hit her with Demacian Justice when she is low. She is easy to finish after a trade.
Stay out of her reach after trades so Perseverance heals you. Use the time to farm.
Spin Judgment only when Renekton is near and your Decisive Strike is ready; the silence stops his Slice and Dice escape.
Press Courage as Renekton hits you with Ruthless Predator; it shields you and cuts the damage, and it makes you harder to stun.
Watch his Fury; once it is high his stun lasts longer and his Slice and Dice hits harder, so back off or save Courage.
Stay out of reach when your health is low and use Demacian Justice when Renekton is low enough to be finished.
Use Decisive Strike when Riven dashes in; it silences her on your next attack and cuts her combo short.
Press Courage just before her Ki Burst lands; the shield and tenacity shorten the stun and soften her burst.
Use Demacian Justice when Riven is low on health; it deals true damage and hits harder the less health she has.
Stay out of fights when you are hurt and wait for Perseverance to heal you, since she is hard to chase down.
Start Judgment when she is next to you and no minions are near, so she is the nearest enemy and takes the most damage.
Close the gap on Rumble while his Electro Harpoon is on cooldown. Walk up through minions so you are harder to hit.
Use Decisive Strike to clear his slow and sprint in. Then hit him to silence him.
Trade with Judgment when Rumble is next to you. It's strongest on a single target, so avoid hitting minions.
Go in when Rumble Overheats. He can't cast spells for a few seconds and his Flamespitter can't hurt you.
Use Courage when Flamespitter or Electro Harpoon is coming at you. It cuts damage, and Rumble deals magic damage.
Step out of The Equalizer's fire quickly. Standing in it costs you a lot of Health.
Finish Rumble with Demacian Justice once he is low on Health.
Hit Sett with Decisive Strike before he can punch you; the silence stops his Haymaker and Facebreaker follow-up for a moment.
Use Decisive Strike to shake off the slow from Facebreaker and keep chasing him.
Press Courage when Sett starts Haymaker; it cuts the damage you take and gives a brief shield.
Keep minions out of Judgment's spin when you trade so Sett takes the full damage; fight him alone.
Take cheap trades while Sett has little Grit stored; hits you take feed Haymaker, so avoid long punch-ups.
Finish a hurt Sett with Demacian Justice; he will out-heal you in long fights as his health drops.
Walk up with Decisive Strike ready; it removes slows from Shen's Twilight Assault and its silence stops him from casting abilities mid-trade.
Step out of the way of Shadow Dash. If Shen misses, jump on him with Judgment while his dash is on cooldown.
Use Courage when Shen's taunt lands on you; it cuts the damage you take while he hits you.
Stay out of Shen's reach after a trade so Perseverance heals you back up.
Finish a low-health Shen with Demacian Justice. Watch for his global ultimate when an ally is in trouble elsewhere.
Do not chase Singed through his Poison Trail. He wants you to follow, and it hurts you the whole way.
Stay out of Mega Adhesive when Singed goes for Fling. Landing in it roots you.
Use Decisive Strike to shake off Mega Adhesive's slow, then hit Singed and silence him.
Press Courage when Singed starts Fling. It shields you and makes you harder to stop.
Use Demacian Justice on a hurt Singed who tries to run. It deals more damage the lower his health is.
Step out of Decimating Smash's line, or walk away as Sion charges it. A long charge is easy to see coming and costly to eat.
Use Decisive Strike to clear the slow from Roar of the Slayer and close the gap. Then hit Sion to silence him.
Press Courage when Sion starts a long charge. The shield and Tenacity shorten the stun.
Spin Judgment with only Sion in range for full damage. Its Armor shred makes later trades hurt more.
Do not finish Sion carelessly with low health. His Glory in Death brings him back with fast, healing attacks, so walk away from him.
Walk up with Decisive Strike ready; it clears any slow Tahm Kench puts on you and speeds you up to close the gap.
Trade with Judgment when Tahm Kench stands alone near you, so every spin hits him and the nearest-enemy bonus lands on him.
Fight him when he has just spent Thick Skin on a shield; he gave up his healing and stores no new grey health for a while.
Hit him and walk away so Perseverance can heal you, because it only starts after you have gone unhurt for a while.
Press Courage before his Tongue Lash stun or Abyssal Dive lands to cut the damage. It also gives tenacity briefly, so you are stunned for less time.
Use Demacian Justice once he is low; the true damage can finish him, and Devour is no help to him once he has been hit by it.
Close the gap when Blinding Dart is on cooldown; Teemo is weak up close and cannot easily escape you.
Use Decisive Strike to remove slows from a Noxious Trap and silence Teemo as you hit him.
Do not walk into brush blindly; Teemo can sit there invisible with Guerrilla Warfare and get a free attack on you.
Use Courage when you are about to take his darts and poison; it cuts the damage you take.
Mushrooms can be shot down by your attacks; clear them where you plan to walk instead of stepping on them.
Finish Teemo with Demacian Justice once his health is low; he cannot easily dodge it.
Hit Tryndamere with Decisive Strike when he steps up; it silences him and removes slows from you.
Do not use Demacian Justice while Undying Rage is active. Wait until it ends, then finish him.
Press Courage when Tryndamere commits to a trade; it reduces his damage and gives you a shield.
Harass Tryndamere early and stay out of reach, so he cannot build Fury or heal with Bloodlust.
Mocking Shout slows you when you face away. Turn and fight, or use Decisive Strike to clear the slow.
Use Decisive Strike to clear Corrosive Charge's slow and run down Urgot. Then silence him so he cannot cast.
Do not walk straight at Urgot when Disdain is ready; it stuns you and throws you back.
Press Courage when Urgot starts Purge; it cuts the damage you take from his steady fire.
Urgot moves slower while he fires Purge, so catch him then and spin Judgment on him.
Stay out of his legs' reach and avoid trading often; each hit stops your Perseverance regeneration.
Save Demacian Justice for when Urgot is hurt; it hits harder the less health he has.
Hit Varus with Decisive Strike when you walk up; he is silenced and cannot cast Piercing Arrow or Hail of Arrows while you trade.
Decisive Strike removes slows and speeds you up, so use it to close the gap if Hail of Arrows slows you.
Use Courage when Varus lands a charged Piercing Arrow or when you are about to be rooted and burst.
Spin with Judgment once you are on top of Varus; he is squishy, and the spin shreds his Armor if it keeps hitting.
Stay out of his long Piercing Arrow range and avoid being poked for free, so Perseverance can heal you.
Finish a low-health Varus with Demacian Justice; he cannot easily escape once you are on him.
Use Decisive Strike to chase Vayne. The speed boost closes the gap, and the silence stops her Tumble.
Stay away from walls when Vayne has Condemn ready. A wall hit stuns you and hurts a lot.
Use Courage when Vayne is about to hit you with a Silver Bolts attack. It cuts the damage you take.
Fight Vayne in the open and spin Judgment once you are next to her. She is fragile and can't stand up to your damage.
Be careful when Vayne uses Final Hour, because her Tumble then makes her invisible. Don't chase her blindly.
Finish Vayne with Demacian Justice once she is low. She has little health, so it kills quickly.
Close the gap with Decisive Strike; the speed boost lets you catch Vladimir, and the silence stops his Sanguine Pool.
Use Decisive Strike to clear Vladimir's slows and run him down.
Do not start Judgment when Vladimir has Sanguine Pool ready; he can vanish while you spin at nothing.
Use Courage to blunt his Transfusion trades and Tides of Blood, and walk up while it is active.
Finish him with Demacian Justice when he is low; Hemoplague healing can bring him back if you wait.
Use Decisive Strike to clear a slow, then hit him to silence him before he can follow up with Thundering Smash.
Press Courage just before his Thundering Smash lands; it cuts the damage and gives a shield and tenacity at the start.
Step out of the Sky Splitter circle once you see him cast it. It takes a moment to land and slows you if it hits.
Stay away from him when you are low. Demacian Justice finishes him off, but only if you get close enough to cast it.
Spin Judgment when only he is near, so he is the closest target and takes the extra damage.
Keep Decisive Strike ready for when Xin Zhao charges in. It frees you from his slows and silences him.
Use Courage as Xin Zhao starts his combo; it cuts his damage and its shield helps against his knock up.
Spin Judgment when Xin Zhao is alone next to you, so he is the nearest enemy and takes the extra damage.
Stay out of damage between fights so Perseverance heals you. Xin Zhao's short trades will cut that off.
Finish Xin Zhao with Demacian Justice once his health is low; Crescent Guard's immunity can stop you reaching him later.
Use Decisive Strike when Yasuo dashes at you or tries to trade; it silences him so he cannot use his abilities for a moment.
Keep Courage ready for his whirlwind or a full trade; it cuts the damage you take and gives you a shield.
Spin Judgment when Yasuo is next to you and no minions are in range, so the full damage lands on him.
Finish him with Demacian Justice once he is low; it deals more damage the less health he has.
Stay out of his hits when you can; Perseverance heals you quickly once you go a while without taking damage.
